title: Adapt the Engram host adapter to A0 work-claim control bindings
outcome: Planning-only follow-up after the A0 control-channel wire settled. HOLD implementation until the work-protocol claim receipt provides a ready-to-paste control_binding. Once available: decode stale_fence as a bind refusal and re-read claim plus rebind without breaker/degraded treatment; route stale_fence from evaluate/begin through claim re-read and rebind within the existing single-retry budget; include checkpoint observations in idempotency identity and distinguish observation scope mismatch from issued-grant checkpoint refusal; treat work_claim_mismatch as a non-retryable session configuration fault. Phase 0 remains unchanged: work_binding and observations stay optional and unknown fields remain ignored.
acceptance: Implementation does not start before the claim-receipt control_binding is available; bind/evaluate/begin stale_fence re-enters through claim read and bind with one retry and no breaker count; malformed or never-valid work_claim_mismatch produces one non-retrying configuration card; checkpoint observation lists participate in idempotency and scope-mismatch classification; Phase 0 compatibility and gates remain green.
